stem.en: Aziza planted tomatoes in May. By August the plants were taller than her, but they had very few tomatoes because she had forgotten to water them during a hot week in July. Question: Why did the plants have few tomatoes?
stem.uz: Matnni oʻqing va savolga javob bering: Aziza planted tomatoes in May. By August the plants were taller than her, but they had very few tomatoes because she had forgotten to water them during a hot week in July. Question: Why did the plants have few tomatoes?
stem.ru: Прочитайте текст и ответьте на вопрос: Aziza planted tomatoes in May. By August the plants were taller than her, but they had very few tomatoes because she had forgotten to water them during a hot week in July. Question: Why did the plants have few tomatoes?

options.en: They did not get water for a week.
options.uz: They did not get water for a week.
options.ru: They did not get water for a week.

options.en: It rained too much in July.
options.uz: It rained too much in July.
options.ru: It rained too much in July.

why.en: The text says she forgot to water them during a hot week.
why.uz: Matnda issiq haftada sugʻormay qoʻygani aytilgan.
why.ru: В тексте: она забыла поливать их в жаркую неделю.

why.uz: Eʼlonda oʻquvchilar tushlikni oʻzlari olib kelishi aytilgan.
